description: 3D Mapping Solutions is a data resource listed in awesome-openx, a curated list of ASAM OpenX road-network and scenario data sets, libraries and tools under the section "Datasets", published or maintained by as named on 3d-mapping.de. Seven surveyed tracks in OpenDRIVE and partly in OpenCRG, including a complex intersection and the inner city of Ingolstadt (complementary to LoD3 models). CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). It can support transport and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-openx-list.
